scope.limitation: Rust entries are the union of locked macOS arm64/x64 normal and build graphs. The Cargo.lock count is a conservative all-platform superset; Windows and Linux remain release checks.

securityRelevantFeatures.consequence: Provider, Web, and Localmail HTTP use Rustls rather than Reqwest's native-TLS default.
Bottie fixes the Rustls crypto provider to ring.
SQLite is compiled into Bottie and the online-backup API is enabled.
Model retrieval and the checksum-pinned ONNX Runtime build input use Rustls.
Only the two reviewed image decoders are selected.
Portable exports and DOCX parsing select only DEFLATE support.
Optional PDF encryption and time support are not selected.
The compatibility API and target-native credential stores are selected.
The native biometric boundary is compiled only on macOS.

assets.name: SQLite amalgamation
assets.delivery: Statically compiled by libsqlite3-sys through rusqlite's bundled feature.

assets.name: sqlite-vec native extension
assets.delivery: Statically compiled into Bottie's Rust binary.

assets.name: Microsoft ONNX Runtime
assets.delivery: A platform archive is fetched and hash-checked by ort-sys at build time, then linked for FastEmbed; the final packaged artefact and notices are not yet captured.

assets.name: EmbeddingGemma 300M Q4 ONNX model
assets.delivery: Downloaded at runtime into Bottie's application cache; not bundled in this repository or current binary. The repository revision and model file hashes are not pinned by Bottie.

assets.name: macOS system frameworks and WebKit
assets.delivery: Dynamically supplied by macOS and not redistributed in the application bundle.
